title: Targeting and dissociating HIF2alpha from the molecular chaperone Hsp70 triggers apoptosis in kidney cancer.
authors: Heritz, Jennifer A; Backe, Sarah J; Pacherille, Angela; Cayaban, Sara J; Basin, Michael F; Smith, Britannia; Sager, Rebecca A; Daneshvar, Michael; Post, Dawn E; Woodford, Mark R; Bourboulia, Dimitra; Chisholm, John D; Mollapour, Mehdi; Bratslavsky, Gennady
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接筛选小分子化合物靶向HIF2α并破坏其与Hsp70互作，虽涉及转录因子和对接方法，但核心是药物抑制与细胞凋亡，非TF-DNA结合机制建模，与本课题关联有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The transcription factor Hypoxia-Inducible Factor 2alpha (HIF2alpha) plays a crucial role in cancer cell adaptation to hypoxic conditions, particularly in clear cell renal cell carcinoma, promoting tumor growth and angiogenesis. Targeting HIF2alpha through pharmacologic inhibition offers a promising therapeutic strategy for HIF2alpha-driven cancers. METHODS: An in silico docking study using 10,000 drug-like compounds was performed using the previously solved X-ray crystal structure of HIF2alpha. Select compounds predicted to bind to the Per-Arnt-Sim-A (PAS-A) and PAS-B domains of HIF2alpha were further evaluated for biological activity in clear cell renal cell carcinoma and normal kidney cell lines. Biochemical and cell-based assays were performed to define the mechanism of action for a lead compound. RESULTS: Here, we identify Compound-c2 as a selective HIF2alpha inhibitor that binds to the PAS-B domain of HIF2alpha. Notably, Compound-c2 disrupts the interaction between HIF2alpha and the molecular chaperone Hsp70, leading to proteasomal degradation of HIF2alpha and the induction of apoptosis in ccRCC. CONCLUSIONS: The distinctive inhibitory mechanism of the HIF2alpha inhibitor identified here, Compound-c2, sets it apart from previous HIF2alpha antagonists. This positions Compound-c2 as a promising alternative with potential applications in addressing drug resistance, providing a unique approach to inhibit HIF2alpha-related processes.
abstract_zh: 背景：转录因子缺氧诱导因子2α（HIF2alpha）在癌细胞适应低氧条件中发挥关键作用，尤其在透明细胞肾细胞癌中，促进肿瘤生长和血管生成。通过药理学抑制靶向HIF2alpha，为HIF2alpha驱动的癌症提供了一种有前景的治疗策略。方法：利用先前解析的HIF2alpha X射线晶体结构，对10,000种药物样化合物进行了计算机模拟对接研究。预测能与HIF2alpha的Per-Arnt-Sim-A（PAS-A）和PAS-B结构域结合的选定化合物，在透明细胞肾细胞癌和正常肾细胞系中进一步评估了其生物活性。通过生化和细胞水平实验，确定了一种先导化合物的作用机制。结果：在此，我们鉴定出Compound-c2是一种选择性HIF2alpha抑制剂，能与HIF2alpha的PAS-B结构域结合。值得注意的是，Compound-c2破坏了HIF2alpha与分子伴侣Hsp70之间的相互作用，导致HIF2alpha经蛋白酶体降解，并在ccRCC中诱导细胞凋亡。结论：本研究中鉴定出的HIF2alpha抑制剂Compound-c2的独特抑制机制，使其区别于以往的HIF2alpha拮抗剂。这使Compound-c2成为一种有前景的替代选择，在应对药物耐药性方面具有潜在应用价值，为抑制HIF2alpha相关过程提供了独特途径。
